name: Pet, Love, Win!
source:
Linelle Hollop (changeable) arrives to New Cork City with one goal in mind: being the most renowned pet salon owner in the city! 

Everything seems fine until she crosses path with an infuriating business rival, whose business is already in the spotlight. When she discovers that winning the Grand Pet Competition could boost her salon's popularity, she decides to enter it...and win!!!


[From [url=https://otojang.itch.io/pet-love-win]itch.io[/url]]
